title: Hold an electrical contractor licence
what: Carry on business as a contractor doing electrical work only while holding a contractor's licence for the occupation and class of the work.

laws.title: Occupational Licensing (Electrical Work) Regulations 2018 (Tas)
laws.provisions: reg 5 (all electrical work is prescribed work)

sources.title: Occupational Licensing Act 2005 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on business as a contractor unless – (a) the person holds a contractor's licence of the occupation and class appropriate to the prescribed work, other than building services work, carried out in the course of the business

sources.title: Occupational Licensing Act 2005 (Tas)
